## Activity

Oakridge Primary Care recorded 36 captures during March 2020. Activity was completed through the site’s planned photographic sessions, with session lists operating as expected apart from routine leave. The available record indicates that the service continued to provide capture activity during the month, with 36 people photographed for subsequent assessment.

## Image quality

Of the 36 captures, 2 were ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 5.6 per cent. The ungradable images could not be assessed for grading purposes. The result should be considered alongside the overall capture activity for March 2020 when reviewing the quality of the service provided at Oakridge Primary Care.

## Grading

Grading identified 0 referable results from the captures assessed. The median lag between image capture and grading was 1 day. This indicates that the typical interval from capture to completion of grading was short during March 2020. Overall, the site recorded 36 captures, with 2 ungradable images and no referable results reported.
